limits: No real Forgejo review or protection/merge behavior is proved by the eleven synthetic-projection tests.
The result has no signature and grants no authority to merge or activate.
issued_at dates validation signature, not a fresh validator execution for this job.
The human personally submits the exact approval; no agent may synthesize or submit it on their behalf.
mandatory_before_operational_authority: A fixed trusted Forgejo collector must establish authentic and complete API projections, including any team-review requests and protected-branch policy; a caller-supplied dict is not human evidence.

The manifest validator must compare every consumed source commit/tree and artifact name/size/hash to the signed attestation as well as validating the complete operational schema. This module intentionally treats manifest bytes as opaque.
Reobserve exact base/head before bounded fast-forward merge, verify resulting main/tree, retain durable outcome, and refuse races or ambiguous results.
Only a separate inaccessible signing identity may sign a domain-separated merge/delivery decision; admission must verify that signature and anti-replay state.
The first-release controller must not be exposed as the ordinary CI deployment backend.
reviewed_bindings: Adopted validation policy hash and actual Ed25519 attestation verification before using signed sources.
Exact repository/source id/revision/tree against PR head, main base and claimed merge base.
Closed observation schema, recent observation, complete reviews, no pending requested reviewers, no boolean ids or extra CI status field.
Adopted human reviewer distinct from PR author and all declared technical actors.
Latest decisive review per user; later comment does not remove approval, later dismissed approval does not revive an earlier approval.
Official current-head approval requires exact visible text containing repository, PR number, head and hash of the raw manifest bytes.
Returned unsigned payload binds selected review id/time, attestation, manifest, base, target, predecessor, merger identity and bounded expiry.
scope: independent source review; no human action, Forgejo API, decision signature, merge or deployment
